tools.name: check_llms_txt
tools.description: Fetch /llms.txt of a site and report whether it exists, whether its links work, and whether /llms-full.txt exists. When there is none, the full report holds a draft built from the site's own pages. Example: "Does example.com have a working llms.txt?"
